fields.name: completed_ns

types.description: Logical terminal result and physical ownership are distinct. Cancel, timeout and device-lost wake waiters but do not prove DMA stopped or pixels visible.

fields.name: device_generation

types.description: Exact registered transport binding; slot zero is software. Kernel assigns the nonwrapping native device generation; successful quiescent reset advances reset_generation. Old fences never name the new incarnation.

types.name: GfxBackendRegistration

fields.name: size

fields.name: adapter_id

fields.name: context

fields.name: operations

types.description: Complete current48-byte native queue callback registration with explicit operations and independent driver memory_generation. Notifications execute through driver_work in task context and consume jobs through take. Callbacks return promptly; no command executes in the submitter or queue metadata lock. Wire version1 remains current. Historical short requests are rejected, never completed with invented operation or epoch defaults. Generic and profiled registration remain distinct explicit current operations.

fields.name: producer_id

fields.name: producer_generation

types.description: Complete current296-byte descriptor taken by its authenticated R4D owner. Exact BO uses persist until complete with proven quiescence or proven whole-device reset; page-bounded segments provide data access. Includes row-copy fields, immutable render state, original deadline, exact output target and authenticated producer identity. Wire version1 remains current; historical short outputs are rejected before taking a job. Renderer leases remain owned by the canonical queue until physical completion.

fields.name: size

fields.name: register_backend

fields.description: Typed callback address for unregister_backend; accompanying SDK C/Zig wrappers define the signature.

fields.name: retain_resource
fields.description: Optional (fence, which, GfxBufferReference*) -> i32: source=0, target=1 of an active job. Actual Init/Work driver and backend generation are checked. Returns mapping-only backing retention; no CPU map, sharing or new execution. Valid after producer exit; rejected for closing/reset/stale/unstarted/released jobs. Release after confirmed DMA/GPU unmaps. Job offsets and length remain the execution extent.

fields.name: register_profile
fields.description: Optional int32_t register_profile(const GfxBackendRegistration*, const GfxBackendProfile*, GfxBackendBinding*). Same actual driver admission and atomic registration as register_backend; copies a bounded vendor-neutral protocol profile. No vendor policy or callback under the common owner. Old 56/64-byte prefixes and wire version 1 remain unchanged.

fields.name: update_operations
fields.description: Optional driver-bound function(binding*, u64 operations)->i32. Changes future admission after engine readiness; accepted jobs remain retained and must finish or fail through normal completion.

fields.name: read_render_list
fields.description: Optional i32 callback(const GfxFence*, GfxRenderList*). Copies the immutable list only for an active job taken by this driver. Full output required; old queue API prefixes remain supported.

fields.name: retain_scanout
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxFence*, GfxBufferReference*). Actual driver Work retains a full read-only source reference of its active direct_present job. Unlike retain_resource this admits a separate read consumer; no writable or private control BO can be fabricated. Release after display DMA-context retirement.

fields.name: begin_scanout
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxFence*). Task-context handoff of an admitted direct_present job after actual Window activation. Publishes logical completion, keeps device-active/resources-held and the IRQ retirement mailbox, but permits unrelated later queue work. Only complete(quiesced=1) after actual final scanout/DMA retirement releases the source. Earlier cancellation/loss is preserved.

fields.name: scanout_retire_requested
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxFence*): 0 keep, 1 retire, negative error. Actual driver Work queries cancellation, producer close or device-loss of an active direct_present source. Cancel on an already activated job requests retirement without changing its completed receipt. No CPU/GPU time limit retires a still displayed image.

fields.name: read_render_color_list
fields.description: Optional int32_t callback(const GfxFence*, GfxRenderColorList*). Copies one immutable color list only for an active job taken by the owning driver. Complete128-byte table tail required.

fields.name: publish_properties
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxBackendBinding*, const GfxBackendProperties*). Actual Init/Work driver publishes one immutable copied payload for its exact live binding. A second publication returns busy. Reset invalidates the payload before admitting a new generation. No callbacks or vendor interpretation under the common owner.

fields.name: read_native_info
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxFence*, GfxNativeJobInfo*). Exact active native job and actual driver owner required; complete output required and unchanged on failure.

fields.name: read_native_data
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxFence*, u32 offset, u8* output, u32 count). Copy up to gfx_native_read_capacity bytes from exact active native metadata. Count must be nonzero and fit; no partial success and output unchanged on failure. No kernel pointer is exposed.

fields.name: read_native_binding
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxFence*, u32 index, GfxNativeBinding*). Exact active native job and actual driver owner required; producer close does not revoke the retained binding. Full output unchanged on failure.

fields.name: queue_owner_info
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxBackendBinding*, u64 timeline, GfxQueueOwnerInfo*). Actual driver and exact current backend required. Returns 1 with logical queue ownership, 0 if the never-reused timeline no longer exists; failure/absence preserves output. Closing or producer exit coalesces a normal backend notification even for an idle queue. Neither this snapshot nor its counters prove GPU quiescence.

types.description: DriverApi v26 optional native queue table; outer ABI unchanged. Register requires bound Init; query and retain_resource accept actual Init/Work. Task callbacks authenticate the backend; complete also accepts actual IRQ owner and only updates bounded metadata plus one worker wake. Mapping-only retention is optional after the 56-byte prefix. The optional 72-byte tail registers a coherent backend profile for userland negotiation; legacy registration advertises no profile. Append-only operation advertisement update keeps queue/device identities stable while engines become ready. Unknown bits and unauthenticated/stale bindings are rejected. Removing a capability never silently releases accepted jobs.

fields.description: int32_t replace_receivers(const GfxReceiverUpdate*). Task-context atomic replacement of resident records; no hardware accesses or callbacks.

fields.name: close_source
fields.description: int32_t close_source(const GfxReceiverSource*). Immediately invalidates metadata and source identity even during retained GPU cleanup; does not authorize any physical resource free.

fields.name: mode_enable
fields.description: int32_t mode_enable(const GfxBackendBinding*). Opt in only after full asynchronous apply/confirm/rollback support and common native takeover. No implicit modeset capability.

fields.name: mode_take
fields.description: int32_t mode_take(const GfxBackendBinding*, GfxDriverModeJob*). 1=job, 0=none, negative=error. Exact current driver owner; task context, nonblocking and success-only output.

fields.name: mode_complete
fields.description: int32_t mode_complete(const GfxDriverModeCompletion*). Nonblocking actual receipt; no waiting, display callbacks or buffer release under the driver owner.

fields.name: audio_publish
fields.description: int32_t audio_publish(const GfxAudioRoute*). Existing display source owner, monotonic publication, task context, bounded copy only.

fields.name: audio_query
fields.description: int32_t audio_query(uint32_t hda_location, uint32_t hda_device, uint32_t index, GfxAudioRoute*). Any bound R4D owner; 1=record, 0=end, negative=error. Output unchanged unless a record was returned.

fields.name: output_pause
fields.description: int32_t output_pause(const GfxOutputId*, uint32_t paused). Bound native R4D task; paused is 0 or 1. Preserve common CPU backing and the identity of any outstanding mode job. Pausing requests cancellation and allows quiesced cancelled upload receipts; CPU painting remains valid without claiming visibility. Resuming is allowed only after the driver has completed the current receiver mode and image. No callback, hardware access, wait or resource release under the catalog owner.

fields.name: mode_restore
fields.description: Optional int32_t(const GfxAtomicState*, GfxModeStatus*): submit a single owned native output with a driver-owned SYSTEM source while output_pause is active. topology_revision=0 snapshots the current revision; exact output generation is still required. Uses the common mode worker and automatically confirms a successful apply, with normal cancellation and physical retirement. Poll the returned ticket through mode_status before resuming output. The producer reference may be released after successful admission.

fields.name: mode_status
fields.description: Optional int32_t(uint64_t ticket, GfxModeStatus*): query the exact nonzero ticket owned by this driver, including final common apply/confirm/rollback settlement. Same result codes as mode_restore; no mutation.

fields.name: color_publish
fields.description: int32_t color_publish(const GfxOutputColorState*). Publishes source color facts for an owned current native output. Invalid/stale or busy retains previous metadata. Optional complete120-byte tail.

fields.name: mode_read_color
fields.description: Optional int32_t callback(uint64_t ticket, uint64_t sequence, GfxDriverModeColor*). Exact128-byte tail required. Only the owning driver can copy metadata for its currently taken job. Returns1 for color,0 for legacy, negative on error; absent/error leaves output untouched.

fields.name: refresh_publish
fields.description: Optional int32_t callback(const GfxOutputRefresh*). Exact136-byte tail; copies current owned output capability, completed state and hardware measurements. No per-frame topology revision.

fields.name: refresh_read
fields.description: Optional int32_t callback(const GfxOutputTarget*, GfxRefreshRequest*). Exact144-byte tail. Copies current intent for an owned output; expired/closed intents are off. Returns1success, negative on error. Driver retains hardware ownership and must disable safely on missing/stale intent.

fields.name: power_publish
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxOutputPower*): actual bound R4D task publishes copied screen lifecycle and physical receipts for its exact connector; no callback, GPU access or resource release under catalog owner.

fields.name: power_read
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxOutputId*,GfxPowerRequest*): exact160-byte pair required. Copies off lease or synthesized wake after program close/expiry. Missing API implies no screen sleep; old144-byte prefix and wire version1 remain stable.

fields.name: brightness_publish
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxOutputBrightness*): bound native driver publishes confirmed completion/failure. No callbacks or hardware under the catalog owner.

fields.name: brightness_read
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxOutputId*,GfxBrightnessRequest*): complete 176-byte pair. Copies latest intent for this owned connection. Missing API provides no brightness control; original prefix and wire version1 remain unchanged.

types.description: DriverApi v27 optional output catalog bridge. The original publish/withdraw prefix requires a real queue. Optional 48-byte tail supports independent receiver metadata sources. Calls require the actual bound R4D init/work/shutdown owner; IRQ handlers defer. Query preserves old caller buffers and reports only the returned prefix size. Optional 72-byte tail provides asynchronous native mode jobs. Original 24/48-byte consumers remain valid; wire version remains 1. Optional 88-byte audio metadata tail preserves the prior 72-byte prefix; wire version remains 1. Optional 112-byte connector-lifecycle tail preserves the 88-byte prefix; wire version remains 1. A driver must negotiate all three callbacks before relying on driver-originated cancelled upload completion or automatic reconnect modes.

types.name: GfxNativeBootInfo

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity, at least the complete version-1 payload.

fields.name: generation
fields.description: Current DisplayManager transition generation; distinct from queue device/reset generations.

fields.name: physical_address
fields.description: Verified contiguous saved firmware framebuffer physical base, zero if unknown.

fields.name: format
fields.description: GfxBufferFormat; only native XRGB8888 currently supports this bridge.

fields.name: policy
fields.description: Existing DisplayManager policy; nonzero prohibits native admission.

types.description: Saved boot scanout for an owner-authenticated R4D takeover. Physical extent is evidence for identifying the original device, never permission for CPU writes after takeover. Format zero means unsupported. No live monitor or VBlank claim.

types.name: GfxNativeRegistration

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity, at least the complete version-1 payload.

fields.name: backend
fields.description: Exact native queue identity with device-execution milestone.

fields.name: output
fields.description: Exact connected output published by this driver.

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Writable caller-owned linear XRGB8888 system BO; descriptor must match boot geometry.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Nonempty zero-terminated backend name; remaining bytes zero.

fields.name: commit_callback
fields.description: int32_t callback(uint64_t context, uint64_t display_generation, const GfxNativeBootInfo*). Called only after firmware writers are revoked; 1 applied, 2 old-preserved, all other values output-lost. Runs under actual DriverApi owner and wait-spanning display execution.

fields.name: restore_callback
fields.description: int32_t callback(uint64_t context, uint64_t recovery_generation, const GfxNativeBootInfo*). Exactly 1 confirms BOTH DMA quiescence and original boot scanout restoration; otherwise all ownership is retained.

types.description: Owner-bound fixed-geometry CPU shadow backend. Kernel retains the BO reference and arbitrates CPU maps versus source upload queue reservations. Driver owns command encoding, device attachment and physical restoration. PCI adapter identity uses 0x01000000 | bus<<8 | device<<3 | function from the existing inventory, not the PCI product ID.

types.name: GfxNativeState

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity, at least the complete version-1 payload.

fields.name: generation
fields.description: Current exact DisplayManager generation, or pending generation for a prepared candidate.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Existing output outcome: validated=0, applied=1, old-preserved=2, lost=3.

fields.name: retained
fields.description: One while the display manager still retains this driver.

types.description: Result of a handled display transition. Generation always names the resulting state, including failed recovery. Successful API handling does not imply successful hardware application; check outcome and retained.

types.name: GfxBootHoldRequest

fields.name: adapter_id
fields.description: Existing PCI display inventory identity, 0x01000000 | bus<<8 | device<<3 | function.

fields.name: generation
fields.description: Exact generation returned by boot_info, before writer revocation.

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Caller reference to the exact-sized snapshot BO.

fields.name: restore_callback
fields.description: int32_t callback(uint64_t context, uint64_t hold_generation, const GfxNativeBootInfo*). Exactly 1 proves whole-device DMA quiescence and that the saved CPU mapping again targets the original boot scanout. The kernel then restores pixels. Every other return retains all ownership. Runs under real driver ownership and wait-spanning display execution, outside metadata locks.

types.description: Early, owner-bound boot-display preservation before firmware initialization. reference is a caller-owned portable system byte BO of exactly pitch*height bytes with CPU read/write usage. The kernel retains its own reference and a read lease after capture; imported writes and device writes are excluded. generation binds the saved boot geometry. The driver must latch effects before any possible GPU state change and must not use a successful capture as proof of VRAM ownership or recoverability.

types.name: GfxDriverDisplayApi

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity; original version-1 prefix is 40 bytes. Query publishes only complete slots within capacity.

fields.name: boot_info
fields.description: int32_t boot_info(GfxNativeBootInfo*). Read-only saved geometry and display policy.

fields.name: prepare
fields.description: int32_t prepare(const GfxNativeRegistration*, GfxNativeState*). Retains candidate, no hardware writes; unchanged geometry only.

fields.name: transition
fields.description: int32_t transition(uint64_t generation, uint32_t operation, GfxNativeState*). Operations commit=0, abort=1, restore=2. Negative errors precede a transition; handled failure returns output-lost with retained ownership.

fields.name: schedule
fields.description: int32_t schedule(const GfxBackendBinding*). IRQ-safe, exact owner/device/reset binding. Coalesces one pending notification on the existing retained graphics worker callback, including idle connector events. No device commands, BO locks or allocation run in this call.

fields.name: boot_hold
fields.description: int32_t boot_hold(const GfxBootHoldRequest*, GfxNativeState*). Revokes normal and firmware CPU writers and copies the complete boot framebuffer including pitch padding into a resident BO before any device effect. No output or queue registration is required. Success outcome validated plus retained=1 is the only admission to the held snapshot.

fields.name: boot_finish
fields.description: int32_t boot_finish(uint64_t generation, uint32_t operation, GfxNativeState*). Operation 0 abandons before device effects, 1 latches retention BEFORE the first possible effect, 2 calls the real driver recovery callback and restores pixels only after quiescence and original scanout mapping are proven. Failed recovery/cleanup retains owner, immutable BO and writer revocation. No hardware callback replay after confirmed recovery followed by cleanup failure. Negative errors do not release the hold.

fields.name: prepare_held
fields.description: int32_t prepare_held(const GfxNativeRegistration*, uint64_t held_generation, GfxNativeState*). Optional same-owner and same-adapter transfer from a captured, effects-latched boot hold. Retains that pending generation, immutable boot RAM image and closed firmware writer gate. Initial shadow pixels come from the captured RAM image. Commit success transfers display ownership; abort or old-preserved removes only the native candidate and retains the original boot hold. Lost output retains both owners. Native restore must prove GPU quiescence and original scanout mapping before captured pixels and retained boot resources can be released. Negative admission errors preserve the hold.

fields.name: presentation_stats
fields.description: int32_t presentation_stats(const DisplayPresentationStats*). Optional task-context publication by the exact bound native R4D owner. Copies metadata only, without waits, BO operations or callbacks. Stale identities, regressing counters and inconsistent visible receipts are rejected atomically. Wire version remains 1.

fields.name: cursor_configure
fields.description: int32_t cursor_configure(const DisplayCursorInfo*). Optional native-primary cursor capability publication by the bound driver; zero flags withdraw only while hidden and idle. Wire version 1.

fields.name: cursor_take
fields.description: int32_t cursor_take(const GfxBackendBinding*, GfxDriverCursorJob*). Returns 1 for one job, 0 when idle, negative gfx_output error. Task context only.

fields.name: cursor_complete
fields.description: int32_t cursor_complete(const GfxDriverCursorCompletion*). Exact taken job receipt; copied metadata and source-lifetime retirement outside the state owner.

fields.name: presentation_info
fields.description: Optional i32(const DisplayPresentationInfo*), task-context publication by the exact bound display owner. Metadata only; preserves original96-byte prefix and wire version1.

fields.name: output_register
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxAdditionalOutput*, GfxOutputTarget*). Register inactive additional output from the actual R4D owner. Copies metadata; success-only target. No hardware callback or framebuffer access.

fields.name: output_transition
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxOutputTarget*,u32 operation,u32 quiesced). Operation0 activates after actual setup; operation1 pauses admission without releasing buffers; operation2 removes only when quiesced=1 and pending queue work is retired. Operations0/1 require quiesced=0. Exact registered target and actual owner required. Never changes the firmware primary.

fields.name: device_reset
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxBackendBinding*,u64 generation,u32 quiesced,GfxNativeState*). Task-context exact driver/backend reset bridge. quiesced=0 accepts the current native or boot-hold display generation, hides output and returns a new recovering generation; retries use the original generation. Zero backend device/reset generations are allowed only before native queue registration. quiesced=1 requires that returned generation and independently proven whole-backend DMA stop, retires queue/mode/cursor/additional-output consumers and allows CPU-resource cleanup. Busy retains an idempotent cleanup record. Neither operation restores bootfb, releases the immutable boot snapshot or acknowledges a visible image.

fields.name: prepare_reset
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxNativeRegistration*,u64 held_generation,u64 reset_generation,GfxNativeState*). After successful quiesced device_reset, prepares a replacement on the same adapter with a strictly newer queue device generation. The original immutable boot hold keeps its own generation; the native candidate receives a fresh display generation. held_generation=0 is valid only without a boot hold. Old callbacks and fences remain stale. Rejected or aborted rebuilding cannot reopen firmware writers; bootfb still requires the original hardware/mapping restore callback.

fields.name: terminal_release
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxBackendBinding*,u64 reset_generation,GfxNativeState*). Terminal system shutdown only, using the already-bound table and actual R4D lifecycle owner. Requires the exact successful quiesced device_reset receipt after all common consumers retired. Releases the immutable boot RAM snapshot without restoring hardware or pixels; display stays unavailable and all firmware/normal writers stay revoked. Output-lost plus retained=0 acknowledges release, not a visible image. Busy retains the same cleanup identity for retry. Exact successful retries are idempotent; foreign, stale, nonretired or ordinary runtime calls cannot release ownership. No new hardware/DMA-stop assertion is accepted here.

fields.name: resume_headless
fields.description: Optional i32(const GfxBackendBinding*,u64 reset_generation,GfxNativeState*). After acknowledged quiesced device_reset retirement, binds a strictly newer live queue device generation of the exact driver/start epoch and adapter without preparing scanout. The display remains recovering/lost with its immutable boot image held and writers revoked. Exact retries are idempotent. The old reset receipt can no longer authorize retirement, terminal release or prepare_reset. A subsequent device_reset(quiesced=0) must name this exact rebuilt backend and current recovering generation; it creates a fresh stop identity and requires new physical quiescence before quiesced=1. No hardware completion is asserted by this call.

types.description: Optional DriverApi v28 native CPU shadow bridge. Boot/prepare/transition require actual bound R4D task/init ownership. Schedule also accepts the actual IRQ owner and coalesces bounded work without BO access. CPU upload operation 2 is accepted only on the kernel-owned queue for the bound BO. Earlier DriverApi offsets remain unchanged. Optional 0.79.10 tails preserve the original 40-byte prefix and DriverApi v28 query slot. Older providers/consumers remain usable through size checks. A held boot display stays preparing with the real pending owner; no native capabilities or reset completion are claimed. It must be abandoned before effects or physically recovered before writers reopen. The optional 0.79.13 prepare_held tail preserves all 56 existing bytes. It transfers the existing held generation without reopening firmware writers. Ordinary prepare/commit cannot bypass a hold; only the explicitly prepared held candidate may commit. Cancellation returns old-preserved only after native candidate cleanup; a remaining boot hold still sets retained=1. Output-lost retains unfinished native cleanup: retry abort with the returned generation. Preparation errors may also return such retained cleanup state, with generation zero if native preparation was never admitted. Native restore cleanup retries do not replay acknowledged hardware recovery. Optional 0.79.14 statistics tail preserves all 64 prior bytes; layout revision 2, wire version 1. Providers publish only complete slots within caller capacity. Statistics reporting is optional and cannot change copy-fence semantics or display ownership. Optional cursor tail preserves the prior 72-byte prefix; layout revision 3/96, wire version 1. Optional0.79.24 output_register/output_transition tail preserves104bytes and wire version1; independent native outputs retain their own state and queue jobs. Optional 0.79.30 device_reset/prepare_reset tail preserves all 120 prior bytes, slot offsets and wire version 1. Layout revision 6, size136. Only the physical R4D owner proves quiescence; the common bridge owns CPU references and generation changes. Reset completion and boot-display restoration remain separate facts. Optional 0.82.1 terminal_release tail preserves the 136-byte prefix and wire version 1; layout revision 7, size144. A completed device reset can release the retained boot image exclusively during terminal system transition, while output remains unavailable. Existing recovery and boot-restoration semantics are unchanged. Optional 0.82.6 resume_headless tail preserves the 144-byte prefix and wire version1; layout revision8, size152. It records a verified new queue after reset without claiming native output; later terminal shutdown requires a new physical stop of that exact backend.

types.name: DriverResourceInfo

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity, at least the complete version-1 payload.

fields.name: handle
fields.description: Opaque nonzero reference. Invalid after owner shutdown or restart; never transferred to another owner.

fields.name: byte_length
fields.description: Exact resource size from the catalog captured before module publication.

fields.name: module_generation
fields.description: Immutable loaded module generation; distinct from the driver start epoch in the opaque handle.

types.description: Named file resource in the exact loaded R4D container. Handle is a non-owning catalog reference, bound to the authenticated driver start and module generation; no path reopening, file lease, allocation or close operation. Bytes/preload loads without a retained file source return source-unavailable.

types.name: DriverFirmwareTableInfo

fields.name: handle
fields.description: Opaque non-owning kernel boot ACPI table identity, distinct from module-resource handles. Never a physical address.

fields.name: byte_length
fields.description: Validated exact ACPI SDT length, including its 36-byte header; at most 1 MB.

fields.name: generation
fields.description: Boot catalog generation encoded in the handle; reinspection and changed contents invalidate old references.

fields.name: signature
fields.description: Four-byte ACPI signature interpreted as a little-endian integer.

types.description: Read-only ACPI root table captured by the platform boot owner. No allocation or close needed. Stat/read use the actual bound R4D init/work owner and are unavailable after its close. Source buffers stay kernel-owned and must never be modified. Errors leave stat output unchanged; discard read output on failure. No AML, ROM execution or vendor-specific parsing occurs in the kernel.

types.name: DriverResourceApi

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity; original 32-byte prefix remains supported.

fields.name: stat
fields.description: int32_t stat(const uint8_t* name, uint32_t length, DriverResourceInfo*). Bounded 1..63 printable ASCII component; case-insensitive, no paths. Captured catalog only, no I/O. Zero success, negative resource error.

fields.name: read_at
fields.description: int32_t read_at(uint64_t handle, uint64_t offset, uint8_t* output, uint32_t length, uint64_t deadline_ns). Exact 1..65536 byte range into caller-owned resident storage. Positive exact byte count on success; negative error otherwise. Zero, expired or unavailable deadlines reject before I/O.

fields.name: now_ns
fields.description: uint64_t now_ns(void). Canonical monotonic nanoseconds, UINT64_MAX if clock unavailable. Used for absolute resource deadlines; no caller-supplied owner.

fields.name: acpi_stat
fields.description: int32_t acpi_stat(uint32_t signature, uint32_t zero_based_index, DriverFirmwareTableInfo*). Optional tail. Reads the complete boot root-table catalog; absent=-5, unavailable/corrupt=-4, changed=-3. No mapping or firmware execution.

fields.name: acpi_read_at
fields.description: int32_t acpi_read_at(uint64_t handle, uint64_t offset, uint8_t* output, uint32_t length, uint64_t deadline_ns). Optional tail. Exact 1..65536 resident bytes from the captured table, checked against boot SHA256 before/after copy and absolute deadline. Positive byte count or negative resource error; partial output must be discarded.

fields.name: platform_query
fields.description: i32 platform_query(DriverPlatformApi*). Optional complete56-byte resource-table tail. Negotiates the external platform driver primitives while preserving the original32/48-byte prefixes and outer DriverApi35. Query once in Init; callbacks admit dedicated owner tasks explicitly.

fields.name: cpu_power_query
fields.description: Optional i32(*DriverCpuPowerApi) owner-bound CPU observation provider service. Negotiate full64byte resource prefix and this nonzero slot before use. No power policy/control.

fields.name: entropy_query
fields.description: Optional i32(*DriverEntropyApi). Negotiate complete72-byte resource prefix and nonzero query slot. External device source registration; no RNG policy or direct caller entropy read in DriverApi.

types.description: Optional DriverApi v29. Stat/read authenticate init/task and driver-work owners; IRQ and storage callbacks are rejected. now_ns is a read-only clock. Per-call owner serialization and filesystem mount-generation admission, with no long-lived mount lease. Handles do not promise immutable storage: firmware consumers must verify pinned size/hash/ABI before use. Reads may modify a partial output on failure; discard it. Absolute nanosecond deadlines are checked before and after synchronous I/O; buffer reuse occurs only after I/O returns safely, so hardware cleanup can exceed the deadline. The optional 48-byte ACPI tail preserves every field in the original 32-byte prefix and outer DriverApi v29 query slot. It exposes read-only boot root tables independently from loaded module file resources. Consumers negotiate both callbacks before using ACPI. Root discovery failure or capacity exhaustion never appears as an empty catalog; corrupt and missing tables are distinct. The56-byte tail adds a separately negotiated DriverPlatformApi for external ACPI/EC execution; the copied boot-table operations retain their existing read-only semantics. The optional64byte resource tail adds a separately negotiated DriverCpuPowerApi for external passive CPU readback ownership. The original56byte prefix and all earlier callbacks retain their meanings; wire header version remains1. The optional72byte tail negotiates DriverEntropyApi; all original32/48/56/64byte prefixes and outer DriverApi37 remain supported, header version1 unchanged.

types.name: DriverHeapAllocation

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity, at least the complete version-1 payload.

fields.name: handle
fields.description: Opaque nonzero CPU allocation identity. Bound to the authenticated R4D start; never wraps or transfers to another owner.

fields.name: cpu_address
fields.description: Resident write-back CPU virtual address, stable until successful release or quiesced owner cleanup. Not a physical, DMA or GPU address.

fields.name: byte_length
fields.description: Exact requested payload length. Contents are uninitialized.

fields.name: alignment
fields.description: Actual power-of-two alignment, at least 16 bytes.

types.description: Owned resident CPU memory for any R4D. A zeroed output never represents ownership. Failed release retains the same handle and complete allocation; callers must not discard it or reuse freed addresses. CPU allocations carry no device mapping, completion or hardware-coherency promise.

types.name: DriverHeapStats

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity, at least the complete version-1 payload.

fields.name: owner_epoch
fields.description: Exact authenticated R4D start epoch. Retained through closing and failed cleanup.

fields.name: allocations
fields.description: Live owned allocations, including unpublished close-race allocations and releases still in progress.

fields.name: backing_bytes
fields.description: Live bytes requested from the resident kernel heap including per-allocation ownership metadata and alignment padding; excludes heap block and VM page overhead.

fields.name: peak_bytes
fields.description: Maximum live requested CPU payload bytes during this driver start.

fields.name: private_allocations
fields.description: Allocations retained without publication because closing won the allocation race.

fields.name: allocation_failures
fields.description: Admitted attempts that failed backing allocation or publication, saturating.

fields.name: releases
fields.description: Successful caller or owner-cleanup releases, saturating.

fields.name: release_failures
fields.description: Backing-release failures retaining complete ownership for retry, saturating.

fields.name: pending_creates
fields.description: Admitted backing allocations not yet published or aborted.

fields.name: pending_releases
fields.description: Detached records awaiting actual backing-release completion.

fields.name: closing
fields.description: One after shutdown closes new allocation admission; release and stats remain available.

types.description: One coherent bounded metadata snapshot for the authenticated driver start. No payload traversal, other-owner inspection, hardware access or global kernel-heap accounting.

types.name: DriverHeapApi

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity, at least the complete version-1 payload.

fields.name: allocate
fields.description: int32_t allocate(uint64_t bytes, uint32_t alignment, DriverHeapAllocation*). Nonzero length and power-of-two alignment, normalized to at least 16. Checked length/padding overflow. Output reset on failure after valid version/size admission; zero success, negative driver_heap error.

fields.name: release
fields.description: int32_t release(uint64_t handle). Exact current-owner allocation only. Successful release invalidates the handle; failed backing release preserves the entire original allocation for retry. A duplicate or foreign handle is stale.

fields.name: stats
fields.description: int32_t stats(DriverHeapStats*). Coherent current-start snapshot, also during shutdown.

types.description: Optional DriverApi v30 resident CPU heap service. Query and calls authenticate actual bound R4D init/shutdown or driver-work context; IRQ and storage callbacks are rejected. No global lifecycle-guard acquisition in worker calls. Metadata is serialized separately from real heap allocation/release, and unwind enrollment covers split operations. Closing rejects new allocations. Owner cleanup reclaims remaining CPU allocations only after callbacks, IRQ, work and DMA have quiesced; in-flight work or release failure retains the closed owner and module. Allocation records scale with resident backing instead of a separate fixed slot pool. This API supplies no DMA or GPU address and no device synchronization; callers keep CPU backing alive through all borrowed device uses.

types.name: DriverThreadRequest

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity, at least the complete version-1 payload.

fields.name: handler
fields.description: int32_t handler(uint64_t context). Trusted resident R4D callback, retained with its argument until completion and thread release. Nonzero.

fields.name: context
fields.description: Opaque callback argument, never copied or dereferenced by the thread service.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Zero for a dedicated BSP thread; driver_thread_flag_parallel permits SMP placement. Optional driver_thread_flag_abortable installs a synchronous self-abort boundary and requires the abort_current service slot. The kernel chooses scheduler placement; other bits are rejected.

types.description: Create a dedicated R4D-owned scheduler Task with a guarded kernel stack and full module FPU state. This is independent of the shared serial Driver Work lanes. Allocation and publication bind to the exact driver-start epoch; failure publishes no handle and retains failed cleanup privately.

types.name: DriverThreadStatus

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity, at least the complete version-1 payload.

fields.name: handle
fields.description: Opaque non-reused thread identity, owned by the authenticated R4D start.

fields.name: task_generation
fields.description: Exact backing scheduler Task generation. Diagnostic identity, not a Task-control grant.

fields.name: cpu_index
fields.description: Last recorded executing CPU; UINT32_MAX before entry.

fields.name: stop_requested
fields.description: One after cooperative stop or parent owner close.

fields.name: result
fields.description: Callback result once completed; cancellation before callback entry reports driver_thread_error_cancelled.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Accepted creation flags, plus driver_thread_flag_aborted after a successful synchronous self-abort. driver_thread_flag_sleeping additionally identifies an actual scheduler-blocked service sleep at snapshot time.

types.description: One coherent thread record snapshot. Completed means execution has returned to the kernel callback boundary, normally or by an explicit self-abort; release additionally retires the exact backing Task and stack before record free. Stop never claims a running callback has been interrupted or that hardware is quiesced.

types.name: DriverThreadStats

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity, at least the complete version-1 payload.

fields.name: records
fields.description: All live owned thread records, including private construction failures and pending release.

fields.name: completed
fields.description: Completed or privately failed records whose backing is retained.

fields.name: private_records
fields.description: Unpublished records retained after failed construction, close race or publication.

fields.name: start_failures
fields.description: Admitted starts that failed allocation, publication or close admission, saturating.

fields.name: releases
fields.description: Successful record releases after exact Task retirement, saturating.

fields.name: release_retries
fields.description: Release attempts retaining Task or record backing for retry, saturating.

fields.name: pending_creates
fields.description: Admitted starts not yet published or failed.

fields.name: waiters
fields.description: Retained join leases across this owner.

fields.name: closing
fields.description: One after the parent closes new thread admission.

types.description: R4D-owned dedicated thread accounting. No fixed thread slot pool: real resident metadata, stack and FPU resources limit admission. Generic cleanup is allowed only after callback quiescence, exact Task retirement and release of every wait lease; failure retains the closed driver and module.

types.name: DriverThreadApi

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity. Original 72-byte and abort-capable 80-byte prefixes remain accepted; returned size identifies complete available slots, at most 88 bytes.

fields.name: start
fields.description: int32_t start(const DriverThreadRequest*, uint64_t* handle). Zero success, negative driver_thread error. Output reset before admission; callback may run before successful return.

fields.name: stop
fields.description: int32_t stop(uint64_t handle). Idempotent cooperative stop; wakes only waits enrolled through this thread service, never arbitrary kernel I/O or lock waits.

fields.name: join
fields.description: int32_t join(uint64_t handle, uint64_t timeout_ticks, int32_t* result). Finite logical scheduler ticks; zero polls, UINT64_MAX is invalid. Self join fails. A stopped dedicated caller can cancel its own exact join wait. Target ownership survives timeout/cancellation.

fields.name: release
fields.description: int32_t release(uint64_t handle). Completed callback and zero wait leases required; retires exact Task/stack before freeing record. Busy or failed release retains the same handle for retry.

fields.name: status
fields.description: int32_t status(uint64_t handle, DriverThreadStatus*). Coherent current-owner snapshot, including during close.

fields.name: current
fields.description: uint64_t current(void). Current dedicated R4D thread handle, or zero outside such a callback. Not a general process or scheduler Task ID.

fields.name: sleep_ticks
fields.description: int32_t sleep_ticks(uint64_t ticks). Current dedicated thread only. Zero yields, finite values wait in logical scheduler ticks, UINT64_MAX waits until cooperative stop. Stop cancels only this service-owned wait. No nanosecond/minimum-delay claim.

fields.name: stats
fields.description: int32_t stats(DriverThreadStats*). Current driver-start accounting, including closed admission.

fields.name: abort_current
fields.description: int32_t abort_current(int32_t result). With a negative result, the current explicitly abortable dedicated Task returns to its kernel callback boundary and this call does not return. Refusals return a driver_thread error. Never aborts another Task, an IRQ, a tracked kernel owner or extra unwind lifetime. Bypasses module stack defers; retained resources and device recovery remain the driver owner responsibility.

fields.name: current_request
fields.description: int32_t current_request(DriverThreadRequest*). Coherent original handler, caller-owned context and creation flags of the actual current dedicated R4D Task, never a selected foreign Task. Invalid output prefix is rejected unchanged; valid output reset before identity check. No allocation or wait. Context lifetime remains with the caller through Task retirement. IRQ/storage and non-dedicated execution have no such binding.

types.description: Optional DriverApi32 dedicated thread service. Authenticates real R4D init/shutdown, Driver Work or dedicated thread execution. Rejects IRQ/storage callbacks; allocating, joining, releasing and sleeping require a sleep-capable task context. The service does not acquire the global R4D lifecycle guard; callbacks progress independently while init/shutdown callers may retain their own lifecycle guard. Task execution-owner binding and hard-kill protection precede publication; cooperative cancellation and bounded join never force a driver callback to return. Closing rejects start, wakes service-owned waits and retains resources until genuine quiescence. Default threads preserve BSP-only code; parallel is explicit and requires the driver to make its shared state SMP-safe.

types.name: DriverSemaphoreStatus

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity, at least the complete version-1 payload.

fields.name: handle
fields.description: Non-reused semaphore identity, bound to this authenticated R4D start.

fields.name: available
fields.description: Unconsumed permits; FIFO handoffs to queued tasks are already consumed.

fields.name: queued_waiters
fields.description: Tasks currently enrolled in the actual kernel semaphore wait queue.

fields.name: active_acquires
fields.description: Retained acquire operations, including woken callers that have not returned.

types.description: Coherent resident semaphore snapshot. A semaphore is a counter, not a task-owned or recursive mutex. Destruction requires the driver to quiesce all users, including holders of already returned permits; the kernel additionally rejects retained acquire operations.

types.name: DriverSemaphoreStats

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity, at least the complete version-1 payload.

fields.name: records
fields.description: All live semaphore records, including private failures and pending destruction.

fields.name: private_records
fields.description: Unpublished records retained after a creation/close race.

fields.name: create_failures
fields.description: Admitted creates that failed backing allocation or publication, saturating.

fields.name: destroy_failures
fields.description: Failed backing frees retaining the same record for retry, saturating.

fields.name: pending_creates
fields.description: Admitted allocations not yet published or failed.

fields.name: pending_destroys
fields.description: Records detached while releasing actual backing.

fields.name: active_acquires
fields.description: Retained acquire operations across this driver.

fields.name: closing
fields.description: One after closing new semaphore creation; existing operations remain available.

types.description: Dynamic driver-owned resident semaphore accounting. No fixed semaphore pool. Generic cleanup runs only after driver callback/IRQ/work/task quiescence and after all acquire leases and construction/destruction transactions finish. Failed free retains backing and module ownership.

types.name: DriverSemaphoreApi

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity, at least the complete version-1 payload.

fields.name: create
fields.description: int32_t create(uint32_t initial, uint32_t maximum, uint64_t* handle). Requires maximum > 0 and initial <= maximum. Resets handle before admission. Allocates real resident kernel backing in sleep-capable task context.

fields.name: acquire
fields.description: int32_t acquire(uint64_t handle, uint64_t timeout_ticks). Zero performs a nonblocking try, including in authenticated IRQ context. Nonzero requires a sleep-capable task: finite logical ticks impose one deadline, UINT64_MAX waits until a real permit handoff. Owner close and dedicated-thread stop never cancel this semaphore wait or fabricate success. Timeout/cancellation/error consumes no permit.

fields.name: release
fields.description: int32_t release(uint64_t handle). Releases exactly one permit, including in authenticated IRQ context. Wakes one FIFO waiter or stores one permit; overflow preserves the counter. No allocation, blocking or callback under the runtime owner.

fields.name: destroy
fields.description: int32_t destroy(uint64_t handle). Requires sleep-capable task context and caller-quiesced users. Active acquire leases cause busy; failed heap release retains the same identity. Concurrent use during destruction is invalid caller behavior.

fields.name: status
fields.description: int32_t status(uint64_t handle, DriverSemaphoreStatus*). Coherent current-owner snapshot; resident and nonblocking.

fields.name: stats
fields.description: int32_t stats(DriverSemaphoreStats*). Coherent current-owner accounting; resident and nonblocking.

fields.name: context_flags
fields.description: uint32_t context_flags(void). Current authenticated execution flags: irq and sleepable. Recomputed per call, zero outside R4D execution. No scheduling or CPU-affinity guarantee.

types.description: Optional DriverApi33 semaphore service using real scheduler wait queues and direct FIFO permit handoff. Authenticates init/shutdown, work, dedicated R4D tasks and actual driver IRQ/storage callback ownership. IRQ/storage callbacks may only use resident nonblocking operations. Creation closes with the parent; existing acquire/release/destruction remain usable for ordered shutdown. Uninterruptible waits require driver-level bounded outer completion and quarantine on failed quiescence, never forced success or unsafe resource release.

types.name: GfxModeStatus

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity, at least the complete version-1 payload.

fields.name: ticket
fields.description: Monotonic transaction ID; zero means no transaction.

fields.name: topology_revision
fields.description: Catalog revision at the last completed transition.

fields.name: commit_sequence
fields.description: Last completed hardware change; not a VBlank fence.

fields.name: confirmation_deadline_ns
fields.description: Monotonic deadline after the candidate became visible; zero outside confirmation.

fields.name: operation_deadline_ns
fields.description: Current driver operation deadline. Expiry alone never proves quiescence.

fields.name: phase
fields.description: gfx_mode_phase_*; terminal lost may still retain both states.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: gfx_output_outcome_*; applied requires actual device completion.

fields.name: retained
fields.description: Old=1, new=2. Includes resources retained for confirmation, even after hardware quiescence.

fields.name: error_code
fields.description: Zero or a negative output error describing the failed operation.

fields.name: output
fields.description: Receiver identity selected by the submitted atomic state.

types.description: Asynchronous native mode transaction. One transaction owns the common primary output; status survives caller exit. Confirmation timeout requests physical rollback. Neither timeout, cancellation nor logical driver removal authorizes freeing live backing.

types.name: GfxDriverModeJob

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity, at least the complete version-1 payload.

fields.name: ticket
fields.description: Transaction identity assigned by the common owner.

fields.name: sequence
fields.description: Fresh operation identity within this transaction; completion must echo it.

fields.name: backend
fields.description: Exact registered device/reset generation and execution milestone.

fields.name: assignment
fields.description: Copied complete single-output assignment. No pointer to application memory survives submission.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Exact published mode; driver must revalidate current receiver and source limits before effects.

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Full reference bound to this driver, held by the common owner. Borrowed until inactive-state retirement completes; driver must not release it.

fields.name: deadline_ns
fields.description: Monotonic operation deadline. A late completion must still report actual quiescence.

types.description: Short nonblocking take/complete protocol serviced through the registered graphics worker notification. Apply retains the complete previous driver state, validates timing, prepares replacement storage and commits it. Confirm retires the previous state; rollback restores it and retires the candidate. Callbacks must never wait for their own worker. No vendor commands belong in the kernel.

types.name: GfxDriverModeCompletion

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity, at least the complete version-1 payload.

fields.name: sequence
fields.description: Exact taken operation; stale and duplicate completions are rejected.

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: Apply: applied or old-preserved; confirm: applied; rollback: old-preserved. Any operation may report output-lost.

fields.name: quiesced
fields.description: Old=1, new=2. Applied requires old quiescence; old-preserved requires new quiescence. Confirm/rollback also require inactive driver resource retirement before acknowledgment.

fields.name: error_code
fields.description: Zero or a negative output error. Logical failures must not invent physical quiescence.

types.description: Actual device-worker receipt, authenticated against the bound R4D owner, backend, transaction and operation sequence. The common owner alone releases its borrowed buffer references after this receipt.

types.name: DisplayPresentationStats

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity; complete version-1 prefix is 208 bytes.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: display_presentation_flag_*; unavailable backends do not fabricate visible completions.

fields.name: head_id
fields.description: Head identifier within the current native primary backend.

fields.name: backend
fields.description: Exact registered adapter, device/reset generations and copy milestone.

fields.name: display_generation
fields.description: Common native display lifetime generation; independent of the device epoch and mode revisions.

fields.name: sequence
fields.description: Monotonic publication sequence for this head and display lifetime.

fields.name: visible_sequence
fields.description: Latest actual visible flip sequence; zero until hardware proves a visible flip.

fields.name: buffer_count
fields.description: Configured private image count; this field never allocates buffers.

fields.name: acquired_count
fields.description: Ordinary Present jobs assigned a free private image.

fields.name: rendered_count
fields.description: Ordinary image copies acknowledged by the copy engine.

fields.name: submitted_count
fields.description: Native Window flips admitted to the bounded worker.

fields.name: visible_count
fields.description: Window activations proven by hardware notifier and head observation.

fields.name: released_count
fields.description: Previous scanout uses with hardware FINISHED; not allocator releases.

fields.name: rejected_count
fields.description: Ordinary Present jobs completed with a failure before successful copy acknowledgment.

fields.name: source_timeline
fields.description: Common queue timeline for the latest visible image; zero for a private image without a queue job. Not a DisplayPresentResult fence.

fields.name: source_point
fields.description: Common queue point corresponding to source_timeline; can revisit older content.

fields.name: render_point
fields.description: Copy engine point that prepared the latest visible image; independent of the common queue point. Zero for explicitly polled scanout receipts; their exact completed copy/display job is identified by source_timeline/source_point.

fields.name: window_point
fields.description: Window notifier point for the latest visible image. Zero for explicitly polled scanout receipts without a Window notifier.

fields.name: submitted_ns
fields.description: Monotonic CPU time when the latest visible flip was submitted.

fields.name: visible_ns
fields.description: Monotonic CPU time when hardware activation and the head event were observed, or when explicitly polled scanout address and subsequent hardware frame progress were jointly confirmed. Not an estimated VBlank instant.

fields.name: gpu_timestamp
fields.description: Raw Window BEGUN GPU timestamp; not converted to CPU nanoseconds. Zero for explicitly polled scanout receipts.

fields.name: irq_sequence
fields.description: Observed head IRQ sequence used by the visible receipt; not an estimated refresh count. Zero for explicitly polled scanout receipts; hardware frame counters must not be relabeled as IRQs.

fields.name: irq_observed_ns
fields.description: Monotonic CPU timestamp of that observed head IRQ. Zero for explicitly polled scanout receipts.

fields.name: released_ns
fields.description: CPU observation of previous-image FINISHED, or confirmed previous-image scanout retirement for an explicitly polled flip; zero while still held.

types.description: Read-only native presentation statistics, separate from the fixed-layout DisplaySummary and existing CPU/common-copy fences. Counters and the latest visible receipt share one coherent bounded snapshot. No IRQ, timer tick, GET or copy completion alone is a visible flip. Explicit polled receipts require completed source work plus the exact active scanout address and subsequent hardware frame progress; notifier, IRQ and GPU timestamp fields remain zero. Initial boot or mode-only receipts carry no completed application source fence. Samples from stale owner/device/display lifetimes are rejected. Boot framebuffer and unsupported providers return unavailable without inventing hardware data.

types.name: DisplayCursorInfo

fields.name: flags
fields.description: display_cursor_cap_*; zero withdraws an already hidden cursor provider.

fields.name: backend
fields.description: Exact native backend and device/reset generations.

fields.name: display_generation
fields.description: Common native display lifetime, independent of mode geometry.

fields.name: max_width
fields.description: Maximum source image width in pixels.

fields.name: max_height
fields.description: Maximum source image height in pixels.

fields.name: min_x
fields.description: Inclusive minimum pointer X including offscreen positions.

fields.name: min_y
fields.description: Inclusive minimum pointer Y including offscreen positions.

types.description: Optional hardware cursor on the native primary head. Straight-alpha ARGB8888, bounded dimensions and hotspot describe the same image used by the caller software cursor. Boot framebuffer and unsupported drivers return unsupported. No inference from GPU brand or a CPU clock.

types.name: DisplayCursorRequest

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Prepare only: caller-owned SYSTEM ARGB8888 source reference; imported and read-held during the asynchronous request.

fields.name: image_sequence
fields.description: Show/move: exact successful prepare sequence. Zero for prepare/hide/release.

fields.name: x
fields.description: Show/move pointer X; hotspot is subtracted by the hardware image plane.

fields.name: hotspot_x
fields.description: Prepare only: hotspot within source width.

fields.name: hotspot_y
fields.description: Prepare only: hotspot within source height.

fields.name: pitch
fields.description: Prepare only: exact first-plane byte pitch, four-byte aligned.

types.description: One finite asynchronous cursor request. Prepare claims the cursor for the program and uploads while hidden. Show waits for the latest successful ordinary Present to become visibly scanned, then activates the prepared image. Move performs cursor-only work. Hide confirms the plane is disabled; release additionally drops the program claim. Unused fields must be zero. Busy preserves the previous request and visible state. Caller death requests confirmed hide/release; unknown hardware completion never licenses software-cursor overlap or unsafe memory release.

types.name: DisplayCursorStatus

fields.name: sequence
fields.description: Latest accepted request; monotonic for the display lifetime.

fields.name: completed
fields.description: Latest terminal request with a confirmed outcome; a lost request is not confirmed.

fields.name: image_sequence
fields.description: Successful prepared image identity; zero if absent.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: display_cursor_state_*; visible is a confirmed hardware state, unknown requires keeping software hidden.

fields.name: error_code
fields.description: gfx_output error for a failed or lost operation, otherwise zero.

fields.name: deadline_ns
fields.description: Finite monotonic request deadline; zero with no pending request.

types.description: Coherent bounded cursor request status. Image-copy, cursor activation and pointer-position receipts remain distinct from desktop frame and copy-fence statistics. No waits or rendering on status reads.

types.name: GfxDriverCursorJob

fields.name: sequence
fields.description: Common request sequence, independent of CE/Core/PIO points.

fields.name: barrier_timeline
fields.description: Show only: latest successful primary Present source timeline.

fields.name: barrier_point
fields.description: Show only: wait for this source point or newer on the same visible scanout timeline; zero pair needs no barrier.

fields.name: request
fields.description: Canonical request; prepare reference belongs to the driver for this borrowed job lifetime.

types.description: Optional serialized R4D cursor job. Only the bound driver may take it once. Imported source access and real GPU/IRQ completion belong to the driver; the common owner retains the source and validates replies. A copy fence alone cannot satisfy the show barrier.

types.name: GfxDriverCursorCompletion

fields.name: error_code
fields.description: Zero for applied; negative gfx_output error otherwise.

fields.name: visibility
fields.description: display_cursor_visibility_*; only real plane confirmation may change this state.

types.description: Driver terminal cursor receipt. Applied and old_preserved require finished CPU source use and all job-specific GPU uses; common borrowed source ownership ends then. Lost retains uncertain ownership. Repeated identical receipts are idempotent, conflicting/stale replies are rejected.

types.name: GfxAudioRoute

fields.name: source
fields.description: Registered display owner and device lifetime.

fields.name: receiver_sequence
fields.description: Exact current receiver batch; zero only before its first capture.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: Strictly increasing publication sequence per connector and source lifetime; exact duplicates are idempotent.

fields.name: connector_id
fields.description: Stable display-owner connector ID, independent of monitor name and enumeration.

fields.name: hda_location
fields.description: Canonical PCI location: bus_kind<<24 | bus<<8 | device<<3 | function. Reserved bits must be zero.

fields.name: hda_device
fields.description: PCI vendor_id in low 16 bits and device_id in high 16 bits, discovered during driver initialization.

fields.name: head_id
fields.description: Display head associated with this confirmed or pending route; zero is valid.

fields.name: device_entry
fields.description: HDA multi-stream device entry (0..3); chosen by display transport, independent of head index.

fields.name: state
fields.description: gfx_audio_route_*; ready requires physical ELD and audio-enable acknowledgements for the active mode.

fields.name: eld_bytes
fields.description: 20..96 bytes, DWORD aligned, only while ready; zero otherwise.

fields.name: port_id
fields.description: Opaque ELD port identity. HDA combines this with its PCI controller and actual codec/pin to identify the route.

fields.name: eld
fields.description: Exact ELD written by the display owner; unused bytes are zero. HDA additionally requires current physical PD/ELDV, coherent readback and supported PCM.

types.description: Bounded display-to-HDA metadata under an existing receiver source. The display R4D owns physical ELD/audio programming; HDA verifies the actual pin ELD against this exact current publication before PCM. The identity tuple is source generation, receiver sequence, publication revision and connector. A head is never an HDA pin or device entry. Source close/reset removes routes; a newer receiver batch invalidates prior ready data immediately. No hardware access, parsing, callbacks or waits in the common registry.

types.name: GfxBackendProfile

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity; complete version-1 payload required.

fields.name: interface_id_lo
fields.description: Vendor-neutral identity of the userland backend protocol.

fields.name: interface_id_hi
fields.description: Upper half of the backend protocol identity.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: Driver protocol revision; zero for no advertised profile.

fields.name: data_bytes
fields.description: Opaque byte count, at most 64; unused bytes must be zero.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Driver-authored protocol payload. Kernel copies these bytes without interpreting vendor details.

types.description: Optional backend protocol metadata. All-zero identity/revision/data means no advertised userland backend. A profile conveys supported software interfaces, not hardware qualification; device/reset generations come only from the accompanying kernel binding.

types.name: GfxBackendInfo

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity; complete version-1 payload required.

fields.name: binding
fields.description: Exact common backend identity and execution milestone.

fields.name: profile
fields.description: One coherent profile captured with that binding.

fields.name: operations
fields.description: Common supported operations, bit N for operation N. A 136-byte legacy result has no operation advertisement.

fields.name: memory_generation
fields.description: Driver-owned memory epoch, independent of the kernel-assigned queue device_generation. Registration zero retains the legacy queue epoch; backend info returns the effective epoch. The kernel also authenticates the registered driver owner when admitting nonportable BOs.

types.description: Complete current152-byte read-only common backend snapshot with explicit operations and independent memory_generation. Inventory slots and capacity do not change. Software and explicit generic registrations have an empty vendor profile; profiled consumers negotiate the backend library and exact binding before work. Vendor protocol identity/data remain unchanged. Wire version1 remains current; historical short outputs are rejected without mutation.

types.name: GfxNativeAllocation

fields.name: memory_generation
fields.description: Exact native memory generation from GfxBackendInfo.

fields.name: deadline_ns
fields.description: Finite absolute monotonic deadline; expires logical work, never proves physical cleanup.

fields.name: byte_length
fields.description: Raw buffer length; zero for an image.

fields.name: format
fields.description: Canonical BO format; zero for raw.

fields.name: usage
fields.description: Transfer source/target, render or scanout; no CPU access.

fields.name: layout
fields.description: 0 linear; 1 driver-native tiled image layout. Driver returns the actual descriptor.

types.description: Copied allocation intent without addresses, pitches or vendor commands. R4D chooses and validates backing. Start is asynchronous; success alone does not create a BO. Receive transfers the canonical reference after completion.

types.name: GfxNativeStatus

fields.name: result
fields.description: 0 pending; 1 allocated; otherwise negative common BO/queue error.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Bit 0: provider claim remains retained, independently of logical completion.

fields.name: completed_ns
fields.description: Logical completion time; zero while pending.

types.description: Caller-owned request status. Receive consumes successful completion; close cancels and drops unreceived backing. Timeout/close/program exit retain any claimed driver operation until its actual completion. Waiters retain the exact slot through task retirement.

types.name: GfxNativeProvider

fields.name: adapter_id
fields.description: Nonzero adapter; one active allocator per adapter.

fields.name: notify
fields.description: Driver Work callback fn(context:usize) callconv(c) i32. Never invoked under the BO owner.

fields.name: context
fields.description: Retained driver context until unregister succeeds.

types.description: Optional driver allocation provider. Actual driver identity is authenticated; repeated notifications are bounded through the existing graphics worker. Unregister closes admission, cancels queued requests and returns busy while callbacks or claimed operations remain.

types.name: GfxNativeJob
types.description: One request claimed by the registered driver. Complete exactly once even after requester close or deadline. Completion borrows the driver reference; it never closes it. A valid received reference keeps backing alive after the driver closes its initial reference.

types.name: GfxRenderRect
types.description: Integer image rectangle. Layout, allocation and GPU addresses derive only from the retained image BO.

types.name: GfxRenderCommand

fields.name: filter
fields.description: Nearest0 or bilinear1. Unused for fill; then zero.

fields.name: transfer
fields.description: Identity0, sRGB decode1 or sRGB encode2. Fill requires identity.

fields.name: source_rect
fields.description: Source pixel rectangle, zero for fill.

fields.name: scissor
fields.description: Destination clip, intersected with the target image.

fields.name: color
fields.description: Fill BGRA/R8 color; ARGB is premultiplied. Zero for sampling.

types.description: Immutable vendor-neutral single 2D draw. Native backend interprets the complete state and validates supported image formats/modifiers; the kernel retains resources and transports state without constructing graphics commands. Source/target alias needs explicit conversion before submission.

types.name: GfxRenderList

fields.name: commands
fields.description: Copied ordered draws; count is 1..16. Unused elements are zero.

types.description: A bounded vendor-neutral render list sharing one canonical source and target. Submission.render repeats commands[0]. Commands share fill/sample kind, filter, blend and transfer; rectangles, colors and opacity may vary. One queue fence retains both complete BOs through all draws. All commands are copied before acceptance; no application pointers survive. A rejected list has no queue side effects.

types.name: DisplayPresentationInfo

fields.name: backend
fields.description: Exact native queue binding; adapter0 for software copy.

types.description: Per-head presentation capabilities and bounded timing metadata. Policy bits select FIFO order, latest-ready replacement, or immediate. FIFO order alone does not imply VSync; only the synchronized flag does. GPU-completion, actual visibility and scanout release remain distinct. interval_ns is the current mode period; observed_sequence/ns identify a real CPU-observed scanout phase, never a synthetic VBlank or converted GPU clock. Zero means unavailable. path0 CPU copy,1 native copy+flip,2 direct,3 overlay. Driver publication is authenticated and monotonic; no frame pointers or pixel access.

types.name: GfxOutputTarget
types.description: Exact output selection for presentation: physical adapter/connector and current device, receiver and display generations plus hardware head. Never a monitor index or a naked head shared across adapters. All fields are copied before admission. The default value with connector0 denotes the legacy implicit primary only inside untargeted driver jobs; explicit calls require a complete nonzero connector and generations.

types.name: GfxAdditionalOutput
types.description: Additional independently presented native output. Exact current published connector, head, geometry and backend; flags/reserved0 are zero. Driver retains its actual scanout resources. Registration admits no hardware effect and leaves output inactive. job_size must name a complete supported GfxDriverJob prefix of at least272 bytes and permanently negotiates the complete target-bearing GfxDriverJob for this backend lifetime. Activation follows real driver modeset completion; pause closes admission; removal requires drained queue work and actual hardware quiescence.

types.name: MouseMotion

fields.name: mouse
fields.description: Existing mouse buttons, wheel, packet counter and legacy position

types.description: Coalesced mouse snapshot plus unclamped cumulative relative movement. motion_x/y are modulo2^32 totals in right/down coordinates. Signed wrapping differences between successive samples preserve every packet, including motion beyond the firmware framebuffer. Callers own virtual desktop position and project it onto their layout. No destructive read or global pointer bounds.

types.name: DisplaySetting
types.description: Copied per-output preference. Stable adapter/connector/receiver identity; signed logical origin; native pixels; scale in 120ths, clockwise rotation0..3; refresh0 means unknown. flags bit0 enabled, bit1 primary. No pointers or transient device generations.

types.name: DisplayLayout
types.description: Complete bounded desired/current desktop layout. Up to eight connected outputs, including disabled entries. The Desktop owns validation, native commits and confirmation. Unused entries retain their defaults; reserved fields are zero.

types.name: DisplayControlRequest
types.description: WINSVC display request. Exact live caller generation, Desktop epoch, monotonically increasing owner-local request ID and current configuration revision. Actions1 test,2 keep,3 revert. Keep/revert name the exact transaction; query uses action0. Identical retries are idempotent.

types.name: DisplayControlStatus
types.description: Desktop-published applied layout and confirmation state. Phase0 ready,1 applying,2 awaiting confirmation,3 reverting,4 kept,5 reverted,6 failed. Deadline is monotonic. Result0 success; negative results never imply persisted or visible output. Flag1 enables settings, flag2 says all active receivers have persistent identities.

types.name: DisplayControlExchange
types.description: WINSVC mailbox exchange restricted to the exact live GUI shell. Desktop publishes status/request acknowledgement and receives at most one copied pending UI request. Response flag1 marks a newly bound broker, requiring rollback of any old active transaction. WINSVC owns transport only, never display policy or hardware.

types.name: GfxSampleGrid
types.description: Exact nearest sampling on a logical pixel grid. enabled0 requires an all-zero record and preserves ordinary sampling. enabled1: target_x/y locate target storage in one native output, rotation0..3 reverses output rotation, scale is in120ths. Native pixel centers select logical cells; viewport coordinates are relative to the output logical origin. Guest-edge sampling selects source_x/y subimages; source_rect supplies the atlas location and extent. Reserved0; integer arithmetic defines ties. No pointers or hardware register values.

types.name: GfxRenderGridList

fields.name: commands
fields.description: Copied ordered draws; count is 1..16. Unused elements are zero.

fields.name: grids
fields.description: One copied grid per draw; unused records are zero.

types.description: Independent fixed list of1..16 copied draws and exact sampling grids. Old GfxRenderCommand/GfxRenderList layouts remain unchanged. Requires render_grid_list capability; one retained queue job and no accepted prefix on error.

types.name: GfxOutputColorState

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity. Version1 accepts the original128-byte prefix; the complete optional link extension ends at192. Partial tails are ignored; query returns128 or192 bytes, never beyond caller capacity.

fields.name: identity
fields.description: Exact current output incarnation; publication never migrates across a hotplug or reset.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: Publication submits zero; query returns the current topology revision. A color change advances the same output activity sequence.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: gfx_output_color_* bits describe implemented source capabilities and the confirmed active state. Never inferred from EDID.

fields.name: format
fields.description: Confirmed scanout FourCC, zero while inactive.

fields.name: bpc
fields.description: Confirmed wire bits per RGB component,8or10; zero while inactive.

fields.name: primaries
fields.description: Opaque COLOR_V1 primaries tag:1sRGB/BT.709,3BT.2020. Zero while inactive. No kernel color conversion.

fields.name: transfer
fields.description: Opaque COLOR_V1 transfer tag:1sRGB,3PQ,4HLG. Zero while inactive.

fields.name: range
fields.description: Opaque COLOR_V1 range tag:1full,2limited at the active wire precision. Zero while inactive.

fields.name: reference_white
fields.description: Confirmed reference white in0.0001cd/m2, matching COLOR_V1; zero while inactive.

fields.name: peak
fields.description: Confirmed target peak in0.0001cd/m2; zero while inactive.

fields.name: formats
fields.description: Implemented scanout formats mask:1XR24,2XR30. Offscreen-only formats are excluded.

fields.name: transfers
fields.description: Implemented output transfer mask uses CTA EOTF bits:1SDR,4PQ,8HLG. Offscreen shader support alone cannot enable HDR.

fields.name: gamma_entries
fields.description: Number of programmable hardware output-LUT entries through an implemented driver path. Zero means unavailable, even when registers exist.

fields.name: degamma_entries
fields.description: Number of programmable hardware input-LUT entries through an implemented driver path. Zero means unavailable.

fields.name: ctm_fraction_bits
fields.description: Implemented hardware color-matrix fractional precision, zero when unavailable. Shader/ICC processing belongs to userland.

fields.name: max_tmds_clock_hz
fields.description: Current source-side TMDS ceiling; zero unknown. Receiver limit is evaluated separately by userland.

fields.name: dp_payload_bits_per_second
fields.description: Confirmed trained DP payload budget after link coding, zero unknown. Not a receiver EDID capability.

fields.name: link_kind
fields.description: Confirmed active transport: gfx_output_link_*; zero unknown or inactive. The original128-byte prefix is unchanged.

fields.name: link_flags
fields.description: Confirmed active link flags: fec=1,dsc=2. Cleared while inactive; capabilities alone never grant active flags.

fields.name: dsc_depths
fields.description: Implemented DSC candidate depths shared by the current source and receiver:1RGB8,2RGB10. Discovery only; every candidate still requires its own PPS, bandwidth, IMP and commit admission.

fields.name: max_frl_rate
fields.description: Known shared source/receiver FRL ceiling:0unknown,1three3G lanes,2three6G,3four6G,4four8G,5four10G,6four12G. Discovery never proves training or timing capacity.

fields.name: compressed_bpp_x16
fields.description: Exact active PPS bits per pixel times16; zero without confirmed DSC. Never reuse for a different mode or color request.

fields.name: link_lanes
fields.description: Confirmed active lane count; zero for TMDS or unknown.

fields.name: link_rate_mbps
fields.description: Confirmed physical bits per second per lane divided by1000000; zero for TMDS or unknown.

fields.name: h_active
fields.description: Active horizontal pixels belonging to this exact confirmed link.

fields.name: h_total
