fields.description: Active total horizontal pixels including blanking.

fields.name: link_payload_bits_per_second
fields.description: Active DP budget after coding/FEC reserve, or FRL16/18 coding ceiling. This is not proof that another timing passes packet, blanking, metering or audio limits.

fields.name: pixel_clock_numerator
fields.description: Exact active pixel clock numerator inHz; divide by pixel_clock_denominator.

fields.name: pixel_clock_denominator
fields.description: Nonzero active pixel clock denominator; zero when unknown or inactive.

fields.name: v_active
fields.description: Active vertical pixels belonging to this exact confirmed link.

types.description: Complete current192-byte immutable source color facts for an exact output incarnation. The kernel authenticates and copies bounded metadata; matrices, ICC, tone mapping, receiver interpretation and link/color policy stay in userland. Missing publication is unsupported, never inferred HDR capability. Wire version1 remains current; historical short128-byte requests are rejected without output or publication mutation.

types.name: GfxRenderColorProgram

fields.name: words
fields.description: Version1 bounded scalar color program. Flags1output mapping and2dither; transfers1sRGB,2linear,3PQ,4HLG; alpha1opaque,2straight,3electrical-premultiplied,4optical-premultiplied. Matrices and luminance policy are owned by userland.

types.description: Bounded immutable userland color program, not executable instructions or GPU addresses. Version1 carries64 uint32 words: flags/source transfer/target transfer/source alpha; target alpha and3zeros; two3x4 float matrices; source and target white/peak/HLG gamma/black lift; source and target range gain/bias; white gain/scaled peak/knee/shoulder; target peak/dither quantum/2zeros;12zeros. Float words are IEEE754 binary32. COLOR_V1 derives these coefficients; R4D validates and lowers them into its fixed shader. The kernel only checks this header and retains the copy. Reserved0. No ICC policy in the kernel.

types.name: GfxRenderColorList

fields.name: commands
fields.description: Copied ordered draws; count is 1..16. Unused elements are zero.

fields.name: program
fields.description: One immutable color program shared by the1..16 compatible draws.

types.description: Independent bounded list with one source/target pair and one color program. Commands require sample, nearest filtering and transfer_color. Kernel retains storage and copied metadata until the actual completion; driver owns native shader execution. Existing lists and command prefixes are unchanged.

types.name: GfxHdrMetadata
types.description: Static metadata, CTA type1. RGB and white xy in1/50000; mastering maximum/CLL/FALL in1cd/m2, minimum in0.0001cd/m2. Zero fields mean unknown, not inferred monitor limits. Userland owns semantic validation and protocol encoding.

types.name: GfxColorSignal
types.description: Explicit output signal and completed userland pipeline. Named color values match GfxOutputColorState. Pipeline bits1linear composition,2output transform,4opaque output; only7 is admitted. Luminance uses0.0001cd/m2. HDR requires metadata_valid=1, RGB10, BT2020 and PQ or HLG. Kernel transports bounded integer metadata and checks source masks; R4GFX/R4D jointly validate receiver, source, bandwidth and metadata. Existing scanout assignment continues to describe the separate canonical SDR console shadow.

types.name: GfxModeColorRequest
types.description: One native mode transaction with a separate encoded output image. State contains exactly one legacy SDR assignment, whose BO remains the canonical CPU console/fallback shadow. Image is a distinct immutable SYSTEM BO in signal.format with matching geometry; it is retained and shared with the driver until confirmation or rollback physically retires this transaction. No payload addresses are retained.

types.name: GfxDriverModeColor
types.description: Optional copied color extension for the exact taken native mode ticket and operation sequence. A zero callback result means a legacy SDR job and leaves output untouched. The reference is owned by the driver and retains the separate encoded image. The old GfxDriverModeJob and its SDR reference remain unchanged.

types.name: DisplayColorSelection
types.description: Copied color selection for one exact connected output. Desktop validates the signal against its complete composition path and owns mode submission, frame observation, confirmation, rollback and persistent stable receiver choice. Output connector_id=0 denotes no color extension in a Desktop exchange.

types.name: DisplayColorRequest
types.description: New display-color service request. Base uses action4 and transaction_id0 to test color on the unchanged current layout. Old DisplayControlRequest and its opcodes remain unchanged. Confirm/cancel use the existing owner-bound actions2/3 and status. This new opcode requires a Desktop using DisplayColorExchange.

types.name: DisplayColorExchange
types.description: New Desktop service exchange with a copied optional color extension for base.request. Input color must be empty. The old exchange remains supported for old Desktops and only carries legacy layout requests. Service performs ownership, prefix, capacity and duplicate checks; all color policy stays in Desktop/R4GFX.

types.name: GfxRefreshCapabilities
types.description: Source and receiver admission for the exact current output/mode. Flags:1known,2capable,4independent heads,8HDR compatible,16LFC implemented. Origin:0none,1EDID continuous range plus DP ignore-MSA,2DisplayID dynamic,3DisplayID Adaptive-Sync,4HDMI Forum. Zero range means unavailable; a frequency range alone is not VRR support. Nominal timing is not measured refresh.

types.name: GfxRefreshStatus
types.description: Confirmed driver state separate from capability and measurement. Phase0fixed,1enabling,2active,3disabling,4faulted,5lost. Active requires actual link/RM/Core completion. Fixed after disable requires completion too. Lost never claims fixed. Reason matches gfx_refresh_reason values. Core point/receipt prove control completion, not visible refresh.

types.name: GfxRefreshMeasure
types.description: Rolling hardware-frame observation, at most32 consecutive intervals. Zero samples means no measured frequency. Sequence and observed_ns identify the last real hardware event; no requested/nominal timing synthesis. Missed counters, clock errors and generation changes invalidate intervals. IRQ observation latency applies; this is not a panel optical measurement. Publication does not advance topology revision or wake all desktop clients per frame.

types.name: GfxOutputRefresh
types.description: Copied VRR source capability, acknowledged state and measured cadence for one exact output target. Driver publication owns all three components. Public reads never infer active VRR from capability, user policy or a wide EDID range. Unsupported backend returns unsupported and keeps fixed presentation.

types.name: GfxRefreshRequest
types.description: Bounded per-output presenter intent. Operations0configure/renew,1release,2report flicker,3explicit clear fault. Policy0off,1animated fullscreen,2animated windows/fullscreen. Scene bits1fullscreen,2animated,4capture. Driver revalidates actual route, image, transitions, HDR and audio; scene never proves hardware capability. Input sequence/deadline must be zero. Kernel returns a monotonically assigned sequence and a1.5s intent lease; unchanged renewals preserve sequence. Presenter renews within500ms. Close, expired lease and release request fixed refresh. One program owner per current output; no callbacks or GPU operations while copying intent. Driver reads return latest copied intent, including synthesized off after expiry; absent API implies fixed.

types.name: GfxDeviceBudgetRequest

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity; complete version-1 payload required.

fields.name: operation
fields.description: gfx_memory_budget_query or gfx_memory_budget_configure. R4DRAW permits query only.

fields.name: memory_generation
fields.description: Nonzero exact provider memory generation; no current-generation alias.

fields.name: limit_bytes
fields.description: Configure: page-aligned provider admission ceiling, zero closes new allocation admission. Query: zero. Shrink preserves all existing charges; this is not a physical allocation guarantee.

types.description: Query or configure one exact provider/adapter/memory-generation admission domain. Only the authenticated R4D may configure it. No allocation or hardware operation is performed.

types.name: GfxDeviceBudgetState

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity; complete version-1 payload required.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: gfx_memory_budget_closing when the provider owner is closing; other bits zero.

fields.name: limit_bytes
fields.description: Provider device-memory admission ceiling; may be below charged_bytes after reduction.

fields.name: charged_bytes
fields.description: All still-charged BO bytes of this provider domain, including pending and retained release.

fields.name: shared_limit_bytes
fields.description: Shared system-memory admission budget. Legacy unconfigured device BOs continue to use this budget.

fields.name: shared_charged_bytes
fields.description: BO charges outside configured provider domains; never inferred from free physical RAM.

fields.name: shared_producer_limit_bytes
fields.description: Shared-memory admission limit per producer; not a preallocated reservation.

types.description: One coherent common-owner accounting snapshot. Provider limits are metadata supplied by its actual R4D; live charges include unfinished allocations and releases. Firmware/private reservations excluded by provider policy are not charged a second time here.

types.name: GfxTelemetryMetric

fields.name: status
fields.description: gfx_telemetry_* validity. Values are zero unless fresh; zero must not imply an available sensor.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Metric9 bit0: valid preceding GPU timer delta. Fresh metrics0/2 may set partial_values with a nonzero bits8..11 availability mask; absent values must be zero. Metric0 may additionally set current_clocks/fabric_clock. All other bits and nonfresh flags zero.

fields.name: source_stamp
fields.description: Driver-source sequence/timestamp; never subtract from a host timestamp.

fields.name: values
fields.description: Signed values in the units defined for the metric index. Unused elements zero.

types.description: One independently validated source group. No cross-group atomicity or measured-frequency claim.

types.name: GfxTelemetryRequest

fields.name: memory_generation
fields.description: Nonzero exact device memory generation; no current-generation alias.

fields.name: metric_mask
fields.description: Bits0..9 select requested metrics; zero reads without extending demand. A time query never creates synthetic GPU workload.

types.description: Nonblocking common-cache query. A nonzero metric mask requests demand for 10 seconds; the existing R4D worker consumes it. No driver callback, allocation or hardware query in this call.

types.name: GfxTelemetryDemand

fields.name: until_ns
fields.description: Absolute host monotonic expiry; zero for no demand.

types.description: Coalesced demand returned to the authenticated provider on every metadata exchange. The finite existing driver worker observes it; no new polling task or callback owner.

types.name: GfxTelemetryState

fields.name: sampled_ns
fields.description: Host observation timestamp; never a GPU clock origin.

fields.name: valid_until_ns
fields.description: Finite host deadline for fresh groups; maximum3 seconds after sampled_ns.

fields.name: source
fields.description: 0 unknown;1 NVIDIA firmware RUSD/optional GPU timer;2 AMD SMU10 mailbox/THM. Source1 clocks are firmware targets. Source2 current clocks explicitly carry current_clocks; fabric frequency is explicitly labeled. Host observation stamps are not GPU timestamps.

fields.name: state
fields.description: 0 unprobed;1 ready;2 rejected;3 host failure;4 closed.

fields.name: policy
fields.description: 0 idle;1 settling;2 desktop;3 multi-output;4 render;5 fullscreen;6 video;7 compute;8 limited;9 stopping.

fields.name: boost
fields.description: Finite accepted host request:0 none;1 one performance level;2 maximum. Not an attained P-state, clock or voltage.

fields.name: control_status
fields.description: Last firmware control status; zero success/unknown according to state. No board-limit setter exists.

fields.name: metrics
fields.description: Indexes:0 target graphics/memory/video/SM Hz;1 NVIDIA RUSD throttle reasons;2 GPU/memory busy percent;3 P-state index;4 requested/enforced GPU limit mW;5 GPU and6 memory millidegrees Celsius;7 average GPU/module/memory mW;8 instantaneous GPU/module/CPU mW;9 GPU global timer ns, optional sample delta ns, and host request/response times ns. Timer intervals are not job durations; clock epochs are not equated. Unavailable fields are explicit. Metric0 current/fabric flags qualify the clock semantics; partial_values makes missing components explicit. Source2 metric5 is the shared APU temperature, not discrete GPU junction temperature; CPU/APU power limits remain unknown unless actually reported.

types.description: Bounded provider-owned telemetry cache. The common owner authenticates publication and marks expired fresh groups stale. It performs no sensor interpretation or power policy. Error preserves the complete caller output.

types.name: GfxOutputPower
types.description: Copied display power state for an exact connector generation. Capability bits1signal retirement,2direct sink power control. MST may stop only its own stream without powering down shared peers. Phase0on,1stopping,2off,3waking,4unavailable. On/off require actual current Core/Window completion; a sink-control receipt is not visible-image proof. Request acceptance never implies completed power change. The GPU, VRAM and system remain running. No S3, S4 or S0ix platform support is advertised by this contract. Zero capability means unsupported (including firmware framebuffer).

types.name: GfxPowerRequest
types.description: Off=1 requests screen sleep; off=0 wakes. Exact connector generation; input sequence/deadline and reserved fields are zero. One program owns a30s off lease, renewed within10s; same intent preserves sequence. Program close or expiry synthesizes wake. Any program may wake immediately. Driver reads consume only copied intent and own all physical actions. New connector/device generations discard old intent; no inherited GPU address or implicit systemsuspend. Result contains assigned sequence/deadline, not physical completion.

types.name: RemoteFrameLease
types.description: Immutable CPU snapshot lease. XRGB32 sRGB/full-range SDR, upright primary logical output, cursor already embedded exactly once; metadata comes from the same acquire call. The pointer remains valid until explicit release or consumer process teardown, even across publish/resize/hotplug/source reset. At most8 leases per program and64 globally; three bounded reusable snapshots shared across consumers, at most64 MB each. No GPU address or display image is lent. Release uses exact id+epoch and actual caller generation; no automatic expiry during network/file I/O.

types.name: RemoteFrameCaptureStats
types.description: Copied CPU publisher/snapshot telemetry. Byte counters separate publication from immutable-reader copies; max_reader_ns measures actual released/stopped lease duration. Three snapshot buffers and one64 MB publisher bound storage; legacy raw map uses two separate bounded buffers. GPU readback copies/latency remain under the userland compositor owner and are never attributed to network I/O.

types.name: GfxVirtualRequest

fields.name: kind
fields.description: 1 independent GPU address range, 2 BO binding into a range.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: Range: bit0 blocklinear, bits8..15 driver-specific page layout (requires bit0, R4DRAW36 and explicit backend support); other bits zero. Layout0 retains legacy behavior. Kernel preserves the ID; the backend must reject unsupported layouts before allocation. Binding flags are zero.

fields.name: adapter_id
fields.description: Exact native adapter; no fallback hardware is selected.

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Caller-owned full BO reference for binding; zero for range.

fields.name: byte_offset
fields.description: Page-aligned offset in the BO, zero for range.

fields.name: virtual_offset
fields.description: Page-aligned offset in parent range, zero for range.

fields.name: alignment
fields.description: Range power-of-two alignment at least 4096, zero for binding.

fields.name: fixed_address
fields.description: Optional aligned fixed range address, zero for binding.

fields.name: deadline_ns
fields.description: Finite monotonic creation deadline. Timeout closes admission; it is not a GPU-idle proof.

fields.name: location
fields.description: Range placement hint: 0 system, 1 device. Binding: zero; backing is resolved from its BO.

types.description: Copied owner-bound virtual-memory intent. No Linux ioctls or caller callbacks. Parent and BO references are authenticated before admission; each resource remains represented until actual backend retirement. No fixed resource-count contract.

types.name: GfxVirtualStatus

fields.name: flags
fields.description: 1 creation settled, 2 backend retired, 4 closing, 8 driver operation claimed.

fields.name: result
fields.description: 0 pending, 1 creation succeeded, negative failure. Inspect retired separately before assuming cleanup.

fields.name: address
fields.description: Acknowledged GPU address, zero unless creation succeeded and resource is not closing.

types.description: Creation outcome and physical retirement are independent. Close mode 0 requests retirement but preserves query/wait; close mode 1 also releases the public handle. Process stop implies mode 1 for all resources. Closing a range retires all its bindings first.

types.name: GfxVirtualToken

fields.name: opaque0
fields.description: Driver-private identity; never exposed as an application capability.

fields.name: opaque1
fields.description: Driver-private identity; never exposed as an application capability.

fields.name: opaque2
fields.description: Driver-private identity; never exposed as an application capability.

types.description: Opaque backend identity retained by the common virtual-resource owner. Zero means no backend resource. The registered driver alone interprets these words.

types.name: GfxVirtualJob

fields.name: token
fields.description: Backend resource to retire; zero for create.

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Canonical full driver-owned BO loan, retained by the broker until backend retirement. Borrowed; the driver must acquire its own use/reference before asynchronous hardware work and must not release this loan.

types.description: One operation on the registered R4D worker. Claims survive caller close, timeout and provider shutdown. Retirement jobs remain available while closing. No application task invokes driver code.

types.name: GfxVirtualCompletion

fields.name: result
fields.description: Create: 1 or negative. Retire: only 1 after confirmed unmap/free or independently proven device reset.

fields.name: token
fields.description: Create success: nonzero backend identity. Create failure: zero and no backend retained. Retire: exact claimed identity.

fields.name: address
fields.description: Create success: acknowledged address. Otherwise zero.

types.description: Completion never substitutes logical cancellation for hardware quiescence. Late successful creation is retained and followed by retirement; it cannot overwrite an earlier timeout. Unknown/partial backend state keeps the driver claim open.

types.name: GfxBackendProperties

fields.name: size
fields.description: Caller capacity; complete version-1 payload required.

fields.name: interface_id_lo
fields.description: Vendor-neutral identity of the userland backend protocol.

fields.name: interface_id_hi
fields.description: Upper half of the backend protocol identity.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: Driver protocol revision; zero for no advertised profile.

fields.name: data_bytes
fields.description: Opaque byte count, at most 256; unused bytes must be zero.

fields.name: data
fields.description: Driver-authored protocol payload. Kernel copies these bytes without interpreting vendor details.

types.description: Optional immutable vendor properties of one exact backend incarnation. Separate from the original 96-byte GfxBackendProfile. Kernel copies bounded bytes and owns no vendor policy. No property is an execution capability. Empty means unavailable; successful publication requires nonzero protocol identity, revision and payload. Lost/reset/unregistered backends never return their former properties.

types.name: GfxNativeSubmission

fields.name: interface_id_hi
fields.description: Upper half of backend profile identity.

fields.name: command_bytes
fields.description: Copied opaque metadata byte count; may be zero.

fields.name: resource_count
fields.description: Number of GfxNativeResource entries, independent of command size.

fields.name: commands
fields.description: Caller byte pointer, nonzero exactly when command_bytes is nonzero; borrowed only for this call.

fields.name: resources
fields.description: Caller aligned GfxNativeResource array pointer, nonzero exactly when resource_count is nonzero; copied before owner admission.

types.description: Copied opaque native command metadata and declared VA bindings. Backend profile identity/revision must match exactly and native operation must be advertised. Driver interprets the private payload; kernel admits lifetime and routing only. No caller address is retained after the call. The submitter must declare all accessed bindings; driver may reject before execution.

types.name: GfxNativeResource

fields.name: binding
fields.description: Public virtual binding handle, kind=bind; a range alone is not executable.

fields.name: access
fields.description: 0 read, 1 read/write. Instruction backing normally uses read.

types.description: One complete, acknowledged public VA binding of this producer and backend memory incarnation. Native admission retains both mapping and canonical BO execution ownership. Aliases and repeated entries are allowed; access applies to the whole binding.

types.name: GfxNativeJobInfo
types.description: Driver-only copied metadata of the exact active native fence. Fetches never complete a job or authorize resource release.

types.name: GfxNativeBinding

fields.name: token
fields.description: Exact private token returned by the acknowledged binding provider.

types.description: Driver-only admitted VA binding snapshot. Token originates in this same driver provider and survives producer close through the active job. Address and size describe the whole binding; common BO execution ownership is retained by the queue, never by this copied token.

types.name: GfxQueueOwnerInfo

fields.name: closing
fields.description: 1 once queue close, producer exit or logical device loss begins; otherwise 0.

fields.name: inflight_jobs
fields.description: Queued or device-active jobs, including cancelled active work until its physical acknowledgement. Not a complete GPU-quiescence proof.

fields.name: retained_jobs
fields.description: Retained job records including references/dependencies/waiters; not a physical activity counter.

types.description: Driver-only logical queue ownership for persistent execution-context retirement. Scope is the exact registered backend incarnation. Closing snapshots may still retain physically active work. A returned zero means no such live queue metadata, not a GPU-stop proof. Query again when notified; close notifications coalesce and contain no per-queue callback.

types.name: WindowGraphicsSurface
types.description: Exact WINSVC, desktop, application and window incarnation. Serial never repeats within a service incarnation; no pointer or GPU address crosses IPC.

types.name: WindowGraphicsFormat

fields.name: color
fields.description: Opaque byte copy of R4GFX R4GfxColorDescription version 1. Desktop validates it through the existing color API; WINSVC does not implement color management.

types.description: One Desktop-admitted canonical pixel format and color description. This is not a Vulkan enum or a hardware-support inference.

types.name: WindowGraphicsConfig
types.description: Desktop-published common window presentation capabilities. Revision changes on geometry/output/color/capability changes; visibility alone does not retire images. At most eight actual format/color pairs; no kernel display policy.

types.name: WindowGraphicsPublication
types.description: Desktop-only publish/remove of a window surface. Surface identifies an existing incarnation for updates; zero surface creates a new incarnation.

types.name: WindowGraphicsRequest
types.description: Application operations on the common GPU window queue. Attach imports an independent BO reference once; present transfers an acquisition token and retained producer fence, never pixels.

types.name: WindowGraphicsFrame
types.description: One compositor lease. Source is borrowed from WINSVC and must be imported before acknowledge/release; producer keeps ready alive until lease retirement. Any GPU consumer must use ready as a dependency.

types.name: WindowGraphicsReply
types.description: Complete response snapshot. A pending consumer fence may be waited outside WINSVC before retrying acquire; a changed revision supports finite service long-poll without periodic GPU polling.

types.name: WindowGraphicsConsumer

fields.name: request_serial
fields.description: Strictly increasing per surface consumer request. Retry the exact latest successful mutation to recover its reply without taking another image.

types.description: Desktop takes a queued image or returns a precise lease after its final compositor/direct-scanout/capture use. A zero return fence is valid only when the image was never submitted to a GPU consumer.

types.name: WindowGraphicsWait
types.description: One finite change waiter per exact participant. Reply signals a metadata revision, never GPU completion. WINSVC restart closes the service request through the existing endpoint owner.

types.name: GfxRenderColorGridList

fields.name: commands
fields.description: Copied ordered draws; count is 1..16. Unused elements are zero.

fields.name: program
fields.description: One immutable color program shared by the1..16 compatible draws.

fields.name: grids
fields.description: One copied grid per draw; unused records are zero.

types.description: Independent bounded1..16 draw list with one copied color program and one exact logical grid per draw. Sample/nearest/transfer_color required. Zero grids preserve ordinary sampling. Native execution shares the existing BO, dependency and completion owner; kernel only transports immutable metadata.

types.name: CpuCapacity

fields.name: available_cpus
fields.description: Currently schedulable CPUs available to ordinary program threads; positive on success.

fields.name: configured_cpus
fields.description: Boot-configured dense CPU slot count; at least available_cpus, includes failed/offline slots.

types.description: Advisory scheduler capacity snapshot; no CPU topology or affinity ownership.

types.name: WindowModeIdentity
types.description: Exact WINSVC/Desktop/application/window incarnation for GUI window mode control. No GPU or graphics surface dependency; serial never repeats within one service incarnation.

types.name: WindowModeRequest

fields.name: identity
fields.description: Query needs owner/window_id; mutation needs the complete published identity.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: 0 decorated window, 1 borderless fullscreen on its current output

types.description: WINSVC mode request. Live owner required. Set IDs increase per window incarnation; identical retries preserve the original operation. Query fields request_id/mode are zero. Fullscreen changes composition geometry, never the display mode.

types.name: WindowModeReply

fields.name: requested_mode
fields.description: Pending or most recently completed requested mode

types.description: Copied mode state. Result0 success,-1 invalid,-2 busy,-3 unavailable,-4 stale,-5 wrong owner. Accepted pending requests are not applied success until Desktop acknowledges; mode always describes the actual publication.

types.name: WindowModeExchange

fields.name: identity
fields.description: Desktop/owner/window required; service/serial bind acknowledgements to the prior response.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Actual mode after handling the prior request

fields.name: flags
fields.description: 1 remove this exact publication; otherwise0 publish/query

types.description: Desktop-only publication and pending-request exchange; reply is WindowModeReply. Request ID plus exact prior identity acknowledges once. Repeated exchanges cannot repeat a completed request; remove and process/service death discard the publication.

types.name: DriverModuleInfo

fields.name: module_version
fields.description: Version retained from module.version metadata at load.

fields.name: firmware_version
fields.description: Declared embedded bundle from firmware.version metadata at load, not device execution.

types.description: Resident metadata from the actually loaded R4D container, retained through its runtime generation. Join to DisplayStateInfo by owner and revalidate display revision/generation. Flags: bit 0 quarantined; bit 1 module version present; bit 2 declared firmware bundle version present. Empty strings mean unavailable. No firmware-execution or device-health claim. Snapshot does not pin the driver. All strings are NUL terminated; reserved is zero.

types.name: GfxOutputBrightness

fields.name: path
fields.description: Admitted brightness path; none when unsupported.

fields.name: current
fields.description: Last confirmed programmed level; meaningful only with current_known. Not a photometric measurement.

fields.name: flags
fields.description: current_known only; failures with uncertain hardware clear it.

fields.name: sequence
fields.description: Nonzero monotonic receipt sequence within this connection.

fields.name: request_sequence
fields.description: Completed or failed request; zero for initial readback. Never acknowledges admission alone.

types.description: Copied driver receipt for an exact native output incarnation. No policy, file I/O or hardware operation in the catalog. Unsupported paths remain explicit.

types.name: GfxBrightnessRequest

fields.name: sequence
fields.description: Zero on input; nonzero admission serial on success. Read by the owning driver; zero means no intent.

types.description: Atomic latest-writer intent. An admitted request survives caller exit until replaced or the connection changes. It is not a hardware completion; observe GfxOutputBrightness. No automatic retry after a driver failure.

types.description: Two independently owned references created atomically. Explicit Close of every reference or exact process retirement closes its direction. Initial endpoint ownership stays in the creating process; LaunchIo is a separate atomic binding contract.

types.name: BytePipeProgress
types.description: One synchronous bounded byte operation. bytes is the exact accepted write prefix or copied read prefix, never peer delivery/drain. State Ready1/WouldBlock2/EOF3/BrokenPipe4/Cancelled5/TimedOut6/Closed7. EOF only after every writer reference closed and all queued bytes drained. flags0. Negative API results leave result and read storage unchanged.

types.name: BytePipeInfo
types.description: Coherent advisory byte channel snapshot. Bounded copied storage, qualified multiple readers/writers serialized per operation. Writes no larger than atomic_limit are all-or-none; larger writes may accept one prefix up to max_step. Scheduling fairness and message boundaries are not promised. No direct caller storage or WaitSource lifetime is retained.

types.name: LaunchIoBinding
types.description: Explicit default Console0 with zero end, or Pipe1 with a live exact caller-owned endpoint. stdin requires Reader; stdout/stderr require Writer. Each Pipe binding creates a distinct child reference even when two streams select the same parent end. Simple copies or default Console never inherit another pipe.

types.name: LaunchIo
types.description: Copied optional Start2 construction request and current-process binding snapshot. Policy0auto/1console/2desktop; console_host0 preserves default/inherited console routing,1terminal_window,2terminal_mode with existing console-class restriction. Three bindings are retained atomically to the exact newly reserved child generation before first Ready. Parent ends stay owned until explicit parent close. Failed pre-publication construction rolls all child refs back; retirement closes child refs after physical threads. stdio query returns borrowed child references, not Dup, and no caller pointer survives return. Existing Start1/Start2 records and reserved_runtime are unchanged.

types.name: Utf8ByteRange
types.description: Half-open UTF8 byte offsets, start<=end. Composition requires pinned R4STD extended-grapheme boundaries in the complete bounded document or preedit text. Not UTF16 units, scalar count or glyph positions.

types.name: CompositionCaret
types.description: Copied caret rectangle in logical view pixels, nonzero height and rational physical-pixel scale. Exact composition view identity/revision binds the observation; no physical render/DPI discovery promise.

types.name: CompositionProvider
types.description: External inputmethod metadata, copied values only. Feature1 supports the bounded UTF8/grapheme protocol; requires full live provider identity and nonzero nonreused provider generation. Feature0 with zero identity/generation is NoProvider, never an installed languageIME. Code/payload ownership stays external.

types.name: CompositionFocus
types.description: New separate acknowledged WINSVC focus sidecar. Full original window/service/desktop/owner identity, exact view and nonwrapping focus incarnation. Input revision and observation tick are freshness context, not focus generation. SDK owner must cancel on its actual local focus/view/provider loss before later events; transport is acquired outside GUI/text locks. No reinterpretation of DesktopFocusSnapshot/GuiEvent.

types.name: CompositionId
types.description: Exact composition identity. Caller editor owner supplies a nonzero never-reused owner generation within the full window lifetime; SDK owner allocates monotonically nonwrapping session generations. Byte copies retain no resource or authority. Focus/view/provider replacement invalidates the session, late events cannot mutate a newer document.

types.name: CompositionEvent
types.description: Bounded copied event header: Preedit1, Commit2, Cancel3. Positive strictly increasing sequence, exact session/provider/focus/view/text revision. Separate text_bytes payload<=1024, strict UTF8/noNUL, whole grapheme selection in event text and replacement in original document. Cancel carries no text/ranges. Preedit never mutates document; only a valid synchronous owner Commit changes complete bytes and increments the exact text revision.

types.name: CompositionFocusReply
types.description: Copied WINSVC focus query result. Zero grants an acknowledged current own-window focused observation, not a future lease. NoFocus/StaleView are explicit; old key and GUI event records remain unchanged.

types.name: CompositionCapabilityReply
types.description: Copied WINSVC inputmethod availability response. No installed qualified inputmethod returns NoProvider and feature0 with zero provider identity/generation. A transport success alone is not a composition capability; no candidate database, language or editor integration is installed by this protocol.

types.name: AudioCaptureSourceId
types.description: Copied exact optional input source: nonzero nonreused R4D registration epoch, provider-local source number and nonwrapping source generation. Zero registration is no source, never a microphone inferred from playback.

types.name: AudioCaptureFormat
types.description: Explicit interleaved PCM; initial S16LE,1..8channels,1..192000frames/second. frame_bytes must equal2*channels. No partial frames, resampler or encoder-as-source.

types.name: AudioCaptureHandle
types.description: Full original AUDSVC process and input registration/source incarnation, stream and nonwrapping session generation. Copies retain no resources; exact owner/client generation remains enforced by AUDSVC. Late/wrong handle never addresses a replacement stream.

types.name: AudioCaptureSourceInfo
types.description: Copied bounded source catalog. ADC and explicitly CONTROLLED virtual input are distinct; playback capability is insufficient. Hardware timestamp support is optional and uses exact clock ID/generation/frequency; unknown values stay zero. Backend sets local source/generation; original bridge stamps registration. Name is bounded UTF8 display metadata, not identity.

types.name: AudioCaptureRequest

fields.name: buffer_bytes
fields.description: Read caller capacity in bytes, at most2048; non-Read operations require0. Whole frames are rejected before activation or dequeue when they do not fit.

fields.name: client_generation
fields.description: Full requesting client generation paired with ServiceMessageHeader.client_id; required by AUDSVC before mutable admission. Infrastructure backend requests use0 and exact handle.service instead.

types.description: Copied capture request. Catalog0 enumerates bounded sources by handle.source.source index with zero registration. Open1 reserves a logical bounded queue; no DMA starts until Read2 on returned exact handle. Query3/Stop4/Close5 keep exact identity. flags0. buffer_bytes carries the final caller output capacity for Read2 and is0 otherwise; do not substitute the larger RPC staging buffer. client_generation binds the exact request sender incarnation; infrastructure backend requests use0 and full handle.service. Service transport op6100; backend callback uses same pointer-only fixed record, no retained caller pointers.

types.name: AudioCaptureReply
types.description: Copied capture result followed by bytes complete PCM in service reads. Transport success separate from result. Nonzero read bytes equal frames*frame_bytes, at most2048. first_frame and cumulative overrun/gap describe discontinuities. Timestamp only with explicit hardware-valid flag and matching source clock; otherwise0. A Stop/Close request alone does not grant hardware-stopped: only genuine driver ACK sets that flag. Negative/unknown completion retains active ownership and DMA/pins; absent registration is quiesced only after original terminal shutdown ACK.

constants.name: driver_work_flag_continuation

A callback may return driver_work_result_continue or driver_work_result_wait to retain its exact ticket and original lifetime while releasing all callback-local owners. constants.name: gfx_queue_operation_present
constants.description: Full XRGB image to the active native output through its retained display owner. Requires backend bit5 and the432-byte submission prefix. Source is a canonical image reference; byte_length=width*4, row_count=height, source_pitch=its plane pitch. Target, both offsets, target_pitch and render state are zero. Common display validates active adapter, geometry and writer/mode exclusion before retaining the whole source with its dependencies. The driver copies into a private inactive scanout. The queue receipt confirms device execution and source retirement, never visible scanout. Visibility remains DisplayPresentationStats. Ordinary queue cancellation/release and producer-death rules apply.

constants.name: gfx_queue_operation_direct_present
constants.description: Full linear XRGB scanout BO to the active native output. Same 432-byte image geometry prefix and output admission as present, additionally scanout usage, verified native layout and backend bit7. Producer dependencies finish before read-only display ownership. Activation completes the logical job while device-active/resources-held remain set until final scanout and DMA-context retirement. Cancel/release/producer close requests restoration to a retained composition image; it never frees active scanout.

constants.name: display_presentation_flag_direct
constants.description: The latest visible receipt scans the submitted source directly. render_point may be zero because no CE copy occurred; source_timeline/point and actual Window/head receipts remain mandatory. released_ns still describes the previous image, never this source.

constants.name: display_presentation_flag_polled
constants.description: Explicitly polled composition-copy scanout receipt: exact source_timeline/source_point identity after the device copy completes, plus exact active address and subsequent hardware frame progress observed by the authenticated driver. This metadata does not complete or retire the common queue fence. visible_sequence counts confirmed submitted images, excluding boot, mode-only and cursor transitions. render_point, window_point, gpu_timestamp, irq_sequence and irq_observed_ns must all be zero; direct is not permitted. The legacy interrupt/notifier validation remains mandatory without this flag. The binary layout and version are unchanged.

constants.name: driver_api_owned_work_version
constants.description: Minimum DriverApi for the optional driver_work_submit_owned callback at offset648, size656. It posts one bounded callback onto normal BSP Driver Work under the authenticated lifecycle owner. Dedicated tasks retain only CPU/thread services; no direct PCI/MMIO/display admission. A context remains alive through completion, cancellation and release. No driver wait or worker join may span the callback.

Real GPU producers use portable system BOs and retain their exact device-execution fences. This flag establishes no active connector, scanout or physical presentation. Transition to an output changes config revision and invalidates existing swapchains.

constants.name: kernel_scheduler_check_case_workers
constants.description: Explicit 30000-tick diagnostic observation of real owned Desktop-compute, Async-file/service and Audio-progress entries/returns. Requires concurrent normal workloads in all four classes; confirms AP execution, exact task/owner generations and returned results. No work is generated, cancelled or owned by this observer. Separate from case_all=127; dormant outside this selected window. Bounded representative original-return receipts are written to the boot log; absence is failed/unavailable, never proof of successful work.

constants.name: kernel_scheduler_check_case_idle
constants.description: Explicit standalone AP idle-timer diagnostic using actual local timer IRQs, stable exact-epoch idle loans and an owned AP worker. Verifies quiet idle, active timer restoration, remote ready and timed wake edges, then exact task retirement. Separate from case_all=127 and workers=128; combinations are rejected. No sampler or work runs outside this explicit request. Slot counts, headers and payload layouts are unchanged.
